thermal_stress_soldering.description: Excessive soldering head temperature, rapid thermal cycling, or preheat-to-soldering thermal shock causing wafer micro-cracking.
thermal_stress_soldering.recommended_action: Recalibrate stringer soldering tip PID controller and inspect thermocouple bonding.

squeegee_pressure_drift.description: Downward squeegee blade force drift causing non-uniform metallization paste thickness and grid line interruptions.
squeegee_pressure_drift.recommended_action: Re-level screen printing squeegee blade and calibrate pneumatic pressure regulator.

screen_mesh_clogging.description: Partially dried silver paste or emulsion aperture blockage causing missing contact fingers.
screen_mesh_clogging.recommended_action: Execute automated ultrasonic screen wash cycle and verify paste solvent viscosity.

firing_thermal_profile_excursion.description: Thermal zone excursion or conveyor belt speed variance causing improper contact burn-through.
firing_thermal_profile_excursion.recommended_action: Perform multi-point thermal profiler pass through furnace and verify belt tachometer.

mechanical_handling_impact.description: Excessive suction cup vacuum, track deceleration shock, or guide pin impact inducing stress cracks.
mechanical_handling_impact.recommended_action: Inspect robotic end-effector vacuum regulator, reduce suction level, and align guide rails.

lamination_pressure_imbalance.description: Diaphragm pressure non-uniformity or heating platen temperature delta causing encapsulation faults.
lamination_pressure_imbalance.recommended_action: Check laminator vacuum diaphragm for micro-tears and verify multi-zone platen heating elements.

ingot_thermal_gradient.description: Asymmetric cooling gradient during Czochralski crystallization causing crystallographic dislocations.
ingot_thermal_gradient.recommended_action: Quarantine wafer lot from current supplier batch and execute incoming EL stress screening.

chemical_texturing_contamination.description: Alkaline/acid chemical texturing bath contamination or surfactant depletion altering surface reflectivity.
chemical_texturing_contamination.recommended_action: Dump and recharge wet bench chemical texturing bath and verify surfactant concentration.

nominal_process_variation.description: Natural manufacturing statistical variation within 3-sigma process control boundaries.
nominal_process_variation.recommended_action: No equipment corrective action required. Continue routine statistical process control monitoring.
